title: Context Packet v0 (checkpoint)
description: DRAFT, experimental. The JSON object cfxd/checkpoint.py writes to checkpoint/<cwd-hash>.json. Machine-checkable companion to docs/specs/context-packet-v0.md; validate with `cfxd packet validate FILE`. Arrays are stored oldest-first. Caps are the writer's constants; JSON Schema cannot express byte caps, so todo text uses maxLength as the closest character limit.

v.description: Format version. Any other value means no packet.

sid.description: Session id as recorded at save time.

created.description: Snapshot time, ISO 8601 UTC. Informational only.

trigger.description: The save path. /compact packets use auto or manual and are not this schema.

cwd.description: Normalized absolute working directory; must match at restore.

saved_at.description: Save time, ISO 8601 UTC. Drives the 60-minute TTL and staleness cutoff.

armed.description: One-shot marker; set false before the block is returned.

commands.description: Masked command strings, oldest first, de-duplicated.

note.description: Optional goal, written by the user at save time.

path.description: Absolute path as the tool call gave it.

lines.description: Line count the tool call returned; null when unknown.

edited.description: Status: true for Edit, Write, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit; false for Read.

t.description: Unix time of the last event touching the file; order is oldest first.

id.description: First 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the saved content.

src.description: File path, masked command, URL without query and fragment, or Grep.

t.description: Todo text; the writer caps it at 120 UTF-8 bytes.

key.description: Recognised runner key, e.g. pytest, npm test, go test.

ok.description: null means the tool response carried no exit status.

at.description: Unix time of the test event.
